headline: IATA Warns Jet Fuel Costs and Regulation Threaten Airline Profitability
summary: The International Air Transport Association warned rising jet fuel prices and increasing regulatory costs are hurting airline profitability. Projected net profit per passenger will drop to $4.50 this year, half of 2025 levels.
why: IATA represents roughly 300 airlines comprising the vast majority of international air traffic.

impacts.name: Global Airlines Sector
impacts.why: Soaring aviation fuel costs and compliance burdens directly compress operating margins across airlines.
